integration: Internet Court + GenLayer + Arkhai Natural Language Agreements
claims: Arkhai locks an ERC-20 reward in an Ethereum Sepolia escrow whose demand identifies a trusted oracle.
A commit-reveal fulfillment is bound to the Arkhai escrow UID before arbitration is requested.
PatchCourt binds the escrow and fulfillment UIDs to a full Git commit SHA and an immutable GitHub file URL.
GenLayer leader and validators independently evaluate each acceptance criterion and compare ordered decisions.
GitHub HTTP errors, mutable refs, SHA mismatches, malformed evidence, and validator disagreement cannot produce approval.
Only a finalized APPROVED or REJECTED PatchCourt verdict produces an Arkhai arbitration instruction.
reproduce: Connect OKX on Ethereum Sepolia and execute the numbered flow.
